item.title: Indian River County families can apply for free or reduced-price school meals starting July 15
item.description: Applications opened today for families to determine eligibility for free or reduced-price meals during the 2026-2027 school year in Indian River County schools.

item.title: Finland House in Lantana celebrates four Panthers players who brought two Stanley Cups
item.description: The Finland Club on Finlandia Boulevard in Lantana has become hockey central for fans of Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov, Anton Lundell, Niko Mikkola and Eetu Luostarinen.

item.title: Marlins give viral dog Jonah special day at loanDepot park in Miami
item.description: Jonah, the dog who went viral for staring at another dog eating a hot dog at Bark in the Park, threw out the ceremonial first pitch Sunday with his owner Peter Silveira.

item.title: England faces Argentina in World Cup semifinal Wednesday
item.description: England and Argentina resume one of the fiercest rivalries in international soccer in the World Cup semifinals on Wednesday in Atlanta, with Spain awaiting the winner in Sunday's final.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with 2-0 win over France
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot after a play by teenager Lamine Yamal, and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain beat France 2-0 on Tuesday to reach its first World Cup final since 2010.

item.title: Atlanta police increase security for Wednesday England-Argentina World Cup match
item.description: Atlanta police will deploy additional personnel and resources for Wednesday's England-Argentina World Cup semifinal after videos showed fans clashing in Miami over the weekend.

item.title: Police investigate death of South Africa World Cup player Jayden Adams at 25
item.description: Cape Town police are investigating the death of South Africa World Cup soccer player Jayden Adams, whose body was discovered Saturday at a property in Cape Town two weeks after helping his team reach the knockout stage for the first time.

item.title: Neighbors worry proposed 85-acre development near I-95 will change St. Lucie County's rural landscape
item.description: The proposed Indrio Town Center off Indrio Road and Russakis Road would bring 447,250 square feet of commercial, retail and possible residential space to land near Interstate 95, with county commissioners expected to vote on rezoning in August.
